description: This file defines the DashboardProvider class, a ChangeNotifier that manages the state related to dashboard category summaries, including loading data from a service, handling errors, and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: DashboardProvider
classes.description: A provider class for managing dashboard summary data, handling loading state, errors, and month selection.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads category summaries for the selected month, updates the loading state, and handles errors.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the selected month and triggers data loading for that month.
